description: A Solana transaction by signature: status, time, fee in SOL and USD, signers, SOL balance changes per account, token balance changes (mint, owner, change) and the programs it invoked. Read-only; nothing is sent. A very new signature may be missing (404, not charged). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

title: Solana Tx
